issues.title: Version Pinning
issues.description: evolith.yaml must specify coreRef.version (semver). Unpinned references are prohibited.

issues.title: Mandatory Architecture Tracker
issues.description: Satellite missing DECISIONS.md in root directory

issues.title: Declared Agent Identity and Capabilities
issues.description: An Agentic AI satellite MUST provide agent.config.json with a stable agent.id and a non-empty capabilities array. - Expected agent.config.json with agent.id and one or more capabilities

issues.title: Explicit Sandbox Boundary
issues.description: agent.config.json MUST declare an isolated sandbox and set both network and process access to deny or allowlist. - Expected sandbox.mode=isolated and deny or allowlist network and process access

issues.title: Prompt and Implementation Separation
issues.description: agent.config.json MUST declare non-empty promptSources and implementationRoots that do not overlap. - Expected non-overlapping promptSources and implementationRoots in agent.config.json

issues.title: Approval for Mutative Tools
issues.description: agent.config.json MUST set toolPolicy.mutative to approval-required. - Expected toolPolicy.mutative=approval-required in agent.config.json

issues.title: Ephemeral Sandbox Resource Limits
issues.description: agent.config.json MUST require ephemeral execution and positive duration, memory, and CPU limits in sandbox. - Expected ephemeral sandbox with positive duration, memory, and CPU limits

issues.title: Untrusted Context Is Data
issues.description: agent.config.json MUST declare contextPolicy.untrustedContent=data-only, provenanceRequired=true, and toolOutputSchemaValidation=true. - Expected data-only untrusted context, provenance, and tool-output schema validation

issues.title: Capability-Scoped, Auditable Actions
issues.description: agent.config.json MUST require scoped-and-expiring capability delegation and append-only action evidence with correlation IDs. - Expected scoped-and-expiring capabilities plus append-only correlated action evidence

issues.title: Operational Budgets and Concurrency Limits
issues.description: agent.config.json MUST declare operationalBudgets with positive maxPromptTokens, maxCompletionTokens, maxContextWindowTokens, an mcpToolConcurrency object with positive maxInFlight and perToolMaxInFlight, and a non-empty runbooksPath that points at a readable runbook document. - Expected positive token, context, and MCP concurrency budgets plus a runbooksPath that exists

issues.title: Satellite Credential Lifecycle
issues.description: agent.config.json MUST declare credentialLifecycle with a positive delegationMaxTtlSeconds, a positive rotationCadenceDays, revocation.onIncident in {immediate, scheduled}, and a positive revocation.maxPropagationSeconds. - Expected positive delegation TTL, rotation cadence, and bounded incident revocation

issues.title: Data Product Designation
issues.description: A Data Mesh satellite MUST provide data-mesh.config.json and declare isDataProduct=true. - data-mesh.config.json does not satisfy DAM-R01

issues.title: Data Contracts
issues.description: data-mesh.config.json MUST declare hasDataContracts=true. - data-mesh.config.json does not satisfy DAM-R02

issues.title: Federated Governance
issues.description: data-mesh.config.json MUST declare federatedGovernance=true. - data-mesh.config.json does not satisfy DAM-R03

issues.title: Mandatory Synchronization Strategy
issues.description: An Edge Computing satellite MUST provide edge-computing.config.json and declare syncStrategy (offline-first, eventual, or real-time-fallback). - edge-computing.config.json does not satisfy EC-R01

issues.title: Edge Node Isolation
issues.description: edge-computing.config.json MUST declare edgeIsolation=true. - edge-computing.config.json does not satisfy EC-R02

issues.title: Conflict Resolution Strategy
issues.description: edge-computing.config.json MUST declare conflictResolution (last-write-wins, merge, or manual). - edge-computing.config.json does not satisfy EC-R03

issues.title: Strict AsyncAPI Contract
issues.description: An Event-Driven satellite MUST provide event-driven.config.json and declare strictAsyncApi=true. - event-driven.config.json does not satisfy ED-R01

issues.title: Transactional Outbox
issues.description: event-driven.config.json MUST declare transactionalOutbox=true. - event-driven.config.json does not satisfy ED-R02

issues.title: Dead Letter Queue
issues.description: event-driven.config.json MUST declare deadLetterQueue=true. - event-driven.config.json does not satisfy ED-R03

issues.title: Inter-Module Contracts are Explicit and Versioned
issues.description: All inter-module communication MUST use explicit contract definitions (Protobuf, JSON Schema, or OpenAPI). Contracts are versioned and backward-compatible. - No contracts directory found

issues.title: Module Data Isolation Enforced
issues.description: No module can directly query another module's persistence layer. All data access goes through the owning module's published interface. - No acl directory for data ownership enforcement

issues.title: Ports and Adapters Boundary
issues.description: All bounded contexts MUST implement hexagonal architecture (core/ADR-0002). Domain layer has zero external dependencies. Infrastructure adapters are injected via ports. - No ports directory found (expected: src/ports or src/application/ports)

issues.title: Inter-Context Communication via Ports
issues.description: Cross-bounded-context communication MUST use explicit application-layer port interfaces. No direct infrastructure-to-infrastructure calls. - No contracts/ directory found for inter-module contracts

issues.title: No Shared Database Across Bounded Contexts
issues.description: Each bounded context MUST have its own database schema or database instance. Shared database is prohibited. - No acl/ directory found (should contain one subdirectory per bounded context)

issues.title: Async Events Use Domain Events
issues.description: When bounded contexts emit events for async reaction, they MUST use domain events with explicit event contracts (core/ADR-0015). No implicit table-polling or direct queue manipulation. - No events directory found

issues.title: Maintain Extraction Readiness Score
issues.description: Satellite MUST track and maintain extraction readiness score per core/ADR-0045. Score MUST be >= 70% to pass Phase 2 Design gate when F2 is planned. - No extraction-readiness.md found in docs/

issues.title: Declared Serverless Contract
issues.description: A Serverless satellite MUST provide serverless.config.json. - serverless.config.json does not satisfy SV-R01

issues.title: Stateless Execution
issues.description: serverless.config.json MUST declare stateless=true. - serverless.config.json does not satisfy SV-R02

issues.title: Bounded Deployment Package
issues.description: serverless.config.json MUST declare a positive package.maxSizeMb not exceeding 50. - serverless.config.json does not satisfy SV-R03

issues.title: Cold-Start Readiness
issues.description: serverless.config.json MUST declare positive coldStart.maxInitMilliseconds and coldStart.lazyInitialization=true. - serverless.config.json does not satisfy SV-R04
